Rick van Logchem <vanlogchem@essb.eur.nl>:
Hi Amin, Our large data collection PARADOx is starting this next Monday. I just noticed in two of our studies (4050 – Tienertips (Jongeren) and 4051 – Tienertips (Ouders)) a very significant portion of our participants are labeled as “test” participant types instead of “main” participants. These are however all our main study participants. I believe this is because our enrollment started before the full license for these studies was applied. Would it be possible for you to change all participants’ type to “main”? I don’t believe there is any way for us to change this from our end? I hope these participants will still receive all surveys as intended, as our study is starting after the weekend. Best regards, on behalf of the PARADOx team, Rick van Logchem Promovendus | PARADOx-Project | Youth & Family Department of Psychology, Education & Child Studies Erasmus School of Social and Behavioural Sciences T +31 6 40 54 84 89 E vanlogchem@essb.eur.nl I www.eur.nl/essb Visiting address Mandeville Building | Room T13-44 Burgemeester Oudlaan 50 | 3062 PA Rotterdam------

Hi Rick,I just came across this question. You are right. We released this feature last month (https://forum.avicennaresearch.com/t/weekly-release-notes-2024-09-10/863) and since then, all participants in a "Trial Study" are marked as "Test" by default.
